# Western Massachusetts

[All metro areas](../data-sources.md)

**Covers:** The Pioneer Valley (Springfield, Holyoke, Westfield, Northampton, Amherst and Greenfield, in Hampden, Hampshire and Franklin Counties) and the Berkshires (Pittsfield, North Adams and Great Barrington). The title bar shows which of these parts a place is in: Pioneer Valley or The Berkshires.

**Counties:** Hampden County, MA; Hampshire County, MA; Franklin County, MA; Berkshire County, MA. Within the service area, the app tells which metro area and which of its parts a place is in by its county, or, on the water or a pier, by the nearest county. [Why these counties](../metro-areas.md#western-massachusetts)

## Operators

| Operator | Runs | Real-time | Key needed |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pioneer Valley Transit Authority (PVTA) | Buses in Springfield, Holyoke, Westfield, Northampton and Amherst, at the University of Massachusetts, and to Ware and Palmer | Yes | No |
| Franklin Regional Transit Authority (FRTA, timetable through Trillium, live data through Passio) | Buses in Greenfield and Franklin County, to Northampton, Orange and Charlemont | Yes | No |
| Berkshire Regional Transit Authority (BRTA, through Trillium) | Buses in Pittsfield, North Adams, Lee and Great Barrington, and the Link413 buses to Greenfield and Northampton | No | No |
| Montachusett Regional Transit Authority (MART) | Shuttle from Athol to Orange | No | No |
| Connecticut DOT | CTrail Hartford Line trains to Springfield | No | No |
| Amtrak | Trains in the area | No | No |
